lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical column of three high-intensity circular blobs is positioned immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, followed by a subsequent column of two larger, high-luminance blobs aligned with the mid-lateral carina.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal carinae to form a grid where high-luminance blobs are centered at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges run across the visible flank, each characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a shadowed lower margin, creating a sharp vertical intensity gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear superficial abrasions are visible on the lateral flank above the pectoral fin; a small remora or attachment mark is visible on the ventral-lateral boundary near the pectoral fin origin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small-diameter (1-3 pixel) high-luminance spots is localized on the cephalic region, transitioning into larger, more widely spaced blobs posterior to the branchial area.
